name: Repetitious Prayer
overview: Scripture instructs believers to avoid prayer that relies on empty, repetitive phrases intended to impress others, as such practices do not please the Father (Matthew 6:1,7). Instead, Jesus encourages sincere, private communication with God, emphasizing heartfelt prayer in secret where God alone sees and rewards (Matthew 6:6). While persistent prayer is commended, as shown in Luke 18:1, it is not the quantity of words but the genuine faith behind them that matters.
